basic_info.description: Expansion potential - grow into the rear addition of the home and basement - ready for your finishing touches to build equity. Home has was appears to be an upgraded concrete, poured-in-place perimeter foundation, newer main electrical panel, newer high efficiency gas furnace, new garage and living space above, etc. Terra Cotta roof tile, stucco exterior and front-facing arched windows project architectural depth. Inside and outside, enjoy arched entries, fenced front and rear yard. Located in sunny Visitacion Valley; Walk to Mission Blue Coffee and all the conveniences on Leland Ave. Bus stop half a block away. Easy access to 101 and 280.
